text:
julia: ALB in us-west-2 reporting ~20% unhealthy targets for service `edge-prod` this morning — TG shows targets DEREGISTERED after ~3 failed health checks. Pods show Ready=3/3. Anyone else seeing this?
opss-bot: ALB target-group tg-0a1b: health check failure rate spike to 21% — alert triggered: https://go/alerts/ALB-TG-HEALTH :rotating_light:
kevin: can you grab ALB access logs + node-side logs? 504 from ALB often = TCP connect problems or SNAT/conntrack issues
julia: pasted a few lines from ALB access logs — nearly all HC requests are 504 from the ALB -> backend, timestamped in a 10m window. From inside node: `curl http://10.2.14.22:8080/health` returns 200 locally:
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
{"status":"ok"}
```
matt: 504s for HC but curl local 200 -> suggests ALB can't complete TCP handshake to pod IP:port. Could be conntrack / ephemeral port exhaustion or host firewall.
carla_sre: what kube-proxy mode are those nodes using? also paste `sudo cat /proc/sys/net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_count` + max if you have it
julia: nodes are kube-proxy=ipvs. grabbed conntrack counters on one of the nodes where targets dropped:
```
$ cat /proc/sys/net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_count
65500
$ cat /proc/sys/net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_max
65536
```
kevin: nf_conntrack_count ~65500 / max 65536 = essentially full. when conntrack table is at capacity new conn entries get dropped -> packets silently dropped -> ALB sees timeouts and marks targets unhealthy. we've hit this mode before with bursty outbound telemetry.
julia: we DID roll a telemetry sidecar last night that opens many outbound connections per pod to external collectors. rolling that back now.
matt: immediate mitigations: rollback the sidecar, throttle egress from the sidecar, or increase conntrack_max temporarily. longer term: increase ephemeral port space by assigning more IPs per node (AWS VPC CNI WARM_IP_TARGET/WARM_ENI_TARGET) or use NAT Gateway scaling.
carla_sre: ops runbook: /runbooks/edge/conntrack.md — short term bump + rollback is fastest. also add alerting when conntrack > 80% of max. :book:
julia: rollback started (rolling update of telemetry sidecar to previous image). will report when complete.
deploy-bot: Deployment julia/edge-telemetry rollback started by julia at 1912350200
julia: rollback finished. ALB target unhealthy rate dropped to ~1.2% and ALB re-registered most targets. recovery window ~30m.
kevin: recommend adding egress rate limits on that sidecar and a test to validate conntrack usage on staging before rollout. add dashboard panel for nf_conntrack_count on each node.
carla_sre: I'll file a follow-up ticket to evaluate NAT scaling in us-west-2 and add automated conntrack remediation (bump sysctl + alert + drain action).
julia: thanks all — closing incident after verification. :thumbsup:
